q.q: How many bits are in an IPv4 address?
q.x: IPv4 addresses are 32 bits, normally written as four 8-bit octets. IPv6 uses 128 bits.

q.q: How many bits are in an IPv6 address?
q.x: IPv6 uses 128-bit addresses, written in eight groups of four hex digits.

q.q: Which OSI layer is responsible for routing packets between networks?
q.x: The Network layer (Layer 3) handles logical addressing and routing. The data link layer forwards frames on a single link.
